faqs.q: Should I choose React Native/Flutter or Native Swift/Kotlin?
faqs.a: For 90% of business applications, React Native or Flutter is perfect. It saves up to 50% in development costs since it uses a single codebase to support both iOS and Android. Native code is only recommended for complex 3D rendering or hardware-intensive architectures.

faqs.q: Do you help publish the apps on the Apple and Google Play stores?
faqs.a: Yes, we take care of the entire store submission process, including metadata configuration, icon setups, policy declarations, and addressing review rejections.

faqs.q: Can the app store data offline?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We configure lightweight local databases (like SQLite or Realm) that store transactional records offline and sync immediately when an internet connection is established.

faqs.q: How long will it take to build a custom website?
faqs.a: A typical corporate starter site takes 7 to 10 working days, while highly custom React/Next.js frameworks take 15 to 20 working days depending on the scope of custom feature integrations.

faqs.q: Do you provide domain registration and web hosting?
faqs.a: We assist in procuring domain names and setting up scalable, secure hosting engines (such as Vercel, AWS, or Hostinger). The actual subscription fee is billed transparently at actual cost.

faqs.q: Will my website be mobile-friendly and optimized for SEO?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Every single layout we design is natively responsive across mobile devices, tablets, and desktops. We also write search engine indexable semantic HTML with proper metadata.

faqs.q: Can I update the copy and images on the website myself?
faqs.a: Yes, we integrate easy-to-use CMS admin panels (like custom dashboards or headless payloads) so your marketing team can edit content and assets without editing the source code.
